top_signals.title: Stocks Rise Ahead of Jobs Report; Oil Gains on Hormuz Uncertainty | Bloomberg Brief 08/07/2026
top_signals.summary: US equity futures edge higher ahead of the July payrolls report. Oil gains as Iranian lawmakers say they would seek to bar US and Israeli ships from the waterway as part of a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Rory Blundell of Gravitee discusses the security risks of AI models "going rogue." Christopher Hodge of Natixis looks ahead to the US jobs report. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Meta ordered to pay $567 million into abatement fund as remedy to child harms case in New Mexico
top_signals.summary: A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay $567 million into an abatement fund after a jury ruled the company violated the state’s unfair practices act.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
